title: Low-Cal Haloumi and Veggie Bake
subtitle: with Sweet Tomato and Parsley Sauce
description: Smacking of bold sunny flavours, this dish of sweet red capsicum, ripe tomatoes and fresh herbs, topped with slabs of grilled haloumi, is big on yum and low on fuss.

steps.text: Prep veggies: Cut the zucchini, capsicum and tomatoes into 3cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Roughly chop the parsley, discarding the stems.

Cook veggies: Preheat the grill to high. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium ovenproof frypan (see Kitchen 101) over medium heat. Cook the zucchini and capsicum, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 mins until golden. Add the garlic and half the cumin and coriander spice blend and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant.

Simmer sauce: Add the tomato, 1 tbs red wine vinegar and 1 tsp honey to the pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 4 mins or until the tomato is starting to break down. Stir in half the parsley, season with salt and pepper, then remove the pan from the heat.

Grill haloumi: Put the rolls on an oven tray. Thickly slice the haloumi. Arrange the haloumi on top of the veggie mixture, drizzle with 2 tsp honey, then grill on the upper oven shelf for 2 mins or until the haloumi is golden. Put the rolls on the lower shelf and cook for 2 mins or until warmed through.
Serve up: Scatter the remaining parsley over the veggies, then divide among bowls or pop the pan in the centre of the table for everyone to help themselves. Serve with the warm rolls and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: If you don't have an ovenproof frypan, you can wrap the handle with a double layer of foil or transfer the veggie mixture to an ovenproof dish before grilling.
